def feats3(g):
    f={}
    nz=[(i,j) for i in range(3) for j in range(3) if g[i][j]]
    zs=[(i,j) for i in range(3) for j in range(3) if not g[i][j]]
    rows=[sum(1 for j in range(3) if g[i][j]) for i in range(3)]
    cols=[sum(1 for i in range(3) if g[i][j]) for j in range(3)]
    color=ginfo(g)[0]
    f['color']=color
    f['minrow']=min(rows); f['mincol']=min(cols)
    f['prodrows']=rows[0]*rows[1]*rows[2]; f['prodcols']=cols[0]*cols[1]*cols[2]
    f['rowvar']=sum(rows)-max(rows); f['colvar']=sum(cols)-max(cols)
    f['fullrows']=sum(1 for r in rows if r==3); f['fullcols']=sum(1 for c in cols if c==3)
    f['rows2']=sum(1 for r in rows if r>=2); f['cols2']=sum(1 for c in cols if c>=2)
    f['corner']=sum(1 for i,j in nz if i in(0,2) and j in(0,2))
    f['edgemid']=sum(1 for i,j in nz if (i,j) in {(0,1),(1,0),(1,2),(2,1)})
    f['center']=1 if (1,1) in nz else 0
    # cells by number of nz 8-neighbors
    for k in range(9):
        f[f'nbr8nz_{k}']=sum(1 for c in nz if sum(1 for d in nz if d!=c and max(abs(c[0]-d[0]),abs(c[1]-d[1]))==1)==k)
    for k in range(5):
        f[f'znbr4_{k}']=sum(1 for z in zs if sum(1 for d in zs if (abs(z[0]-d[0])+abs(z[1]-d[1]))==1)==k)
    # Chebyshev distance-2 pairs
    f['dist2']=sum(1 for a in nz for b in nz if a<b and max(abs(a[0]-b[0]),abs(a[1]-b[1]))==2)
    f['manh2']=sum(1 for a in nz for b in nz if a<b and abs(a[0]-b[0])+abs(a[1]-b[1])==2)
    f['manh3']=sum(1 for a in nz for b in nz if a<b and abs(a[0]-b[0])+abs(a[1]-b[1])==3)
    f['manh4']=sum(1 for a in nz for b in nz if a<b and abs(a[0]-b[0])+abs(a[1]-b[1])==4)
    # nz symmetric under 180 rotation
    f['sym180']=sum(1 for i,j in nz if g[2-i][2-j])
    f['symTR']=sum(1 for i,j in nz if g[j][i])
    f['symanti']=sum(1 for i,j in nz if g[2-j][2-i])
    # 2x2 all-empty blocks
    f['2x2empty']=sum(1 for i in range(2) for j in range(2) if all(not g[i+di][j+dj] for di in range(2) for dj in range(2)))
    # longest horizontal/vertical run
    best=0
    for i in range(3):
        run=0
        for j in range(4):
            if j<3 and g[i][j]: run+=1; best=max(best,run)
            else: run=0
    for j in range(3):
        run=0
        for i in range(4):
            if i<3 and g[i][j]: run+=1; best=max(best,run)
            else: run=0
    f['hvrun']=best
    f['count_minus_maxcol']=len(nz)-max(cols)
    f['count_minus_maxrow']=len(nz)-max(rows)
    f['maxrow_minus_maxcol']=max(rows)-max(cols)
    f['ncolor']=len(set(v for r in g for v in r if v))
    return f
